title: DFS Subtree Return State
summary: Choose the smallest summary each subtree should return so its parent can compute its own answer in one postorder-style traversal.
recognition_signals: a parent result depends on information from child subtrees
recomputing child properties would repeat work
one DFS can propagate a compact summary upward
core_rules: A subtree return value should contain exactly the information its parent and ancestors still need.
If failure must short-circuit, encode it explicitly in the returned state or paired status.
structural_steps: state what the parent needs from each child
combine them at the current node
update any global or paired answer if needed

common_confusions.distinction: Simple decompose/combine may return the final subtree answer directly. DFS return-state problems often return an auxiliary summary, such as height, that enables a larger parent-level result.
